# ABOUT THE UNION [italic]An information sheet prepared by the mission for colonists of other nations.[/italic]
## ONE UNION OF MANY PEOPLES The [bold]Union of Progressive Peoples[/bold] was founded in 2108, when the peoples of Russia, China, Germany and Spain chose common cause over the rule of corporations. Vietnam and many nations of Asia and Eastern Europe have joined since. Today the Union is the only great power of human space that answers to its people and not to a board of shareholders.
## HOW THE UNION IS GOVERNED - The [bold]President[/bold] leads the Union from Earth. - The [bold]Premier[/bold] chairs the state council and directs the ministries. - The [bold]Governor-General[/bold] administers the frontier worlds, supported by the naval task force. - Every Union colony has a [bold]mayor[/bold], responsible for its daily life and its production quota.
## THE FRONTIER The Union settles hard worlds that others overlooked. Rations are shared fairly, housing is assigned by need, and every citizen has work. Our habitable colonies are crowded, and the Union is expanding to give its families room. We build with what we have and improve what we take apart. Hardship shared is hardship halved.
## WHO DEFENDS THE UNION - The [bold]Naval Infantry[/bold], carried by the fleets wherever the Union expands. - The [bold]Territorial Guard[/bold], the workers of each colony standing their turn under arms. - The [bold]People's Armed Police[/bold], who keep order on Union worlds. - The [bold]Space Operating Forces[/bold], whose work is not discussed.
## A NOTE ON RUMOURS Corporate news services describe the Union as closed and secretive. The Union prefers the word [italic]disciplined[/italic]. Reports that the Ministry of Space Security keeps an office on this colony are false. Questions about the Union may be put to the mission in writing.
